params.text: Direction changed per the owner: open level classes are now the user-acquisition hook (the dictionary stays public but is no longer pitched). Built, not committed: 6 open classes (Sơ cấp 1/2, Trung cấp 1/2, Cao cấp 1/2) taken from NIKL leveled words (초/중/고급, each level split in half by word length). Their words are generated by scripts/build-open-class-words.mjs into src/data/openClassWords.ts (server only) and openClassTrial.ts (20 trial words per class, about 60KB on the client). /classes is public: guests try 20 words, then "Đăng ký để học tiếp" opens sign-up, and the chosen class is remembered in sessionStorage so the user joins it automatically after login. The API action join_open creates the class on first join, owned by the oldest admin, with 50-word lessons as assignments (deterministic ids, staggered due dates), and approves the student straight away. The sidebar moves "Lớp học" into the main nav; the login page has a "Học thử lớp" CTA. Pulled 3 commits from origin/main (TOPIK archive and others) and resolved the sitemap conflict; /topik/archive stays out of the sitemap because guests can't open it. Tested locally with wrangler pages dev, local D1 and bsk: guest list, trial, sign-up modal, auto-join after login, Vào học shows 35 ordered lessons, card review saves progress. RISK: no migration creates class_assignments.total_cards (unk_7df192f90b96b944); check production before deploying. Local .wrangler D1 now holds test users u_test_admin/u_test_student.
